faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.ctaText: Still have questions? Contact our consultant directly.

q1.a: We sell high-quality 1:1 replica watches produced by top factories. Every piece is carefully inspected for quality before shipment.

q2.q: How do I place an order?
q2.a: Contact us via WeChat or WhatsApp with the model you like. We will confirm stock, price and arrange delivery for you.

q3.a: We ship via fast express with tracking. Domestic delivery usually takes 1-3 days; international shipping takes about 5-10 days.

q4.q: Do you offer returns or exchanges?
q4.a: Yes. If the watch arrives damaged or not as described, we support exchange or refund within a certain period.

q5.a: Every watch includes after-sales support. If any movement issue occurs, we provide repair or replacement service.

q6.a: We support secure payment methods. Specific options are confirmed by our consultant when you place the order.
